clue.text: State pair going round Hawaii

indicators.note: the pair of noughts goes round the outside of the state abbreviation

parts.note: in cricket a pair is two ducks, a nought in each innings, written as two Os
HI is the US postal abbreviation for Hawaii

explanation.surface: A couple travel around the Hawaiian islands on holiday.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pair' is cricket slang: a batsman out for nought in both innings scores a pair.
explanation.definitionFit: Ohio is one of the fifty constituent states of the USA.

clue.text: Flier be evasive before two disputes

parts.note: to hedge is to avoid committing oneself, to be evasive
a spar is a sparring argument, a dispute
a row is a quarrel, the second dispute

explanation.surface: A pilot dodges questions ahead of a pair of arguments.
explanation.definitionFit: The dunnock is a small brown bird, and any bird is a flier in crosswords.

clue.text: How beggar might be giving generously?

definitions.meaning: a beggar holds out a hand with palm up, asking for coins
liberal and free in giving, a figurative sense of an unclenched hand

explanation.surface: Asks how a beggar might look while receiving someone's generosity.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone liberal with money is said to give with an unclenched palm, the opposite of tight-fisted.

clue.text: Barbara heard after Mason on the line

indicators.note: the singer's surname is spoken, and its sound is spelt another way

parts.note: Barbara Dickson is a Scottish singer and actress

explanation.surface: Barbara is overheard following a man called Mason on the telephone.
explanation.walkthrough: The Mason-Dixon line is the historic boundary between Pennsylvania and Maryland, dividing North from South in the USA.
explanation.definitionFit: The surveyor named second after Charles Mason in the boundary's name, the Mason-Dixon line.

clue.text: We have changed direction first on the snow

indicators.note: the opening letter is a compass point, west, which is swapped for another point of the compass, north

parts.note: contracted, we have becomes we've

explanation.surface: We turned around before heading out across the snowfield.
explanation.walkthrough: W at the start of WE'VE is west; swapping it for N (north) gives the snow word.
explanation.definitionFit: Névé is granular, partly compacted snow at the top of a glacier.

clue.text: One of a number gamely knocked over

definitions.text: One of a number gamely knocked over

parts.words: One of a number gamely knocked over
parts.note: a pin in a game where a ball is bowled to topple a set of nine wooden pins

explanation.surface: Someone among a group bravely toppled over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gamely' looks like 'pluckily' but means 'in a game'.
explanation.definitionFit: Skittles is a pub game in which a set of wooden pins is knocked down by a thrown ball.

clue.text: Artist had morphine regularly

indicators.note: every second letter of the drug's name is taken, at regular intervals

explanation.surface: A painter was found to have been taking morphine routinely.
explanation.definitionFit: John Opie was an eighteenth-century Cornish portrait and history painter.

clue.text: Juliet replaced first beat from singer of old type of music

indicators.note: one letter is swapped out of the singer and another put in its place

parts.note: a bass is a singer with the lowest male voice

indicators.note: only the opening letter of beat is meant

parts.note: J is Juliet in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Juliet took over the first beat from a vocalist of an old musical style.
explanation.definitionFit: Jass was an early spelling of jazz, the music style, before the modern form settled.

clue.text: Three Greek characters from oldest of American college societies

definitions.meaning: three letters of the Greek alphabet in sequence
the academic honour society founded in 1776 at William and Mary, the oldest US fraternity of its kind

explanation.surface: Three Greeks from the oldest American college clubs.
explanation.definitionFit: The honour society is named by three Greek letters, and it is the oldest US college fraternity.

clue.text: Lazy fish left inside

indicators.note: the abbreviation for left goes within the fish

parts.note: the ide is a freshwater fish, also called the orfe

explanation.surface: A sluggish fish was left lying in the tank.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe someone unwilling to work or be active.

clue.text: Pressure of doing too much bowling

definitions.text: Pressure of doing too much bowling

parts.words: Pressure of doing too much bowling
parts.note: in cricket bowling is delivered in overs, so strain from bowling a great many of them

explanation.surface: The strain caused by overdoing it at the bowling alley.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as OVERS STRESS: the stress from bowling too many overs, the six-ball units of a cricket innings.
explanation.definitionFit: Emphasizing something excessively is laying too much weight on it, matching pressure from overdoing things.

clue.text: Said one's first explanation be prolix

parts.note: verbal means spoken or said aloud rather than written
one is gives I + S, the Roman one and the contracted is

indicators.note: only the opening letter of explanation is taken

explanation.surface: Someone said their first explanation was long-winded.
explanation.definitionFit: To put things into wordy speech is to be long-winded, using more words than needed.

clue.text: Jack's drink messenger took from unofficial receiver

definitions.text: Jack's drink messenger took from unofficial receiver

parts.words: Jack's drink messenger took from unofficial receiver
parts.note: a sailor (Jack Tar) drinks rum; a runner who carried it to illicit buyers was a smuggler

explanation.walkthrough: RUM is the sailor's (Jack's) drink, and a RUNNER is a messenger; the whole describes a liquor smuggler.

clue.text: Invaders are prepared going over a range

indicators.note: the letters are made ready in a new order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Invaders are ready to cross a mountain chain.

clue.text: Do be taken off drug when gas is found

parts.note: methadone is a synthetic opioid used to treat heroin addiction
taken as written

explanation.definitionFit: Methane is the main component of natural gas.

clue.text: Drink one took from South African encampment

indicators.note: the letter for one is removed from the encampment word

parts.note: a laager is a defensive circle of wagons, a South African camp
a means one, as in a single thing

explanation.surface: Someone grabbed a drink from a camp in South Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: Lager is a type of light beer, a common drink.

clue.text: Unknown character taken in by an Etonian wrong to be taking without permission

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: the unknown letter is placed inside the rearranged letters
the old boy's letters are put wrong, in a new order

parts.note: x is the classic algebraic unknown

explanation.walkthrough: 'wrong' turns the old boy's letters into NEATION.

clue.text: Premier building for tail-ender

definitions.meaning: Downing Street's best-known house, the British Prime Minister's residence
in cricket, a batsman who goes in late in the order, near the tail

explanation.surface: A building suited to a cricketer who bats at the bottom.
explanation.definitionFit: The Prime Minister lives at 10 Downing Street, and a batsman in tenth place is a tail-ender.

clue.text: Found Scotch

parts.note: the past tense of find, in the Scots dialect

explanation.surface: Someone has discovered a bottle of whisky.

clue.text: No jolly type

parts.note: taken as written
a jolly is slang for a Royal Marine, abbreviated RM

explanation.surface: Someone is not a cheerful kind of person.
explanation.definitionFit: A norm is a standard or usual pattern, as is a type.

clue.text: Front seaplane malfunctioning about start of descent

clue.text: In London area officer hesitantly went round bend for fizzy water

indicators.note: the three pieces surround the bend-shaped letter

parts.note: SE is a London postal district, south-east
Lt is the abbreviation for lieutenant
er is the sound of someone hesitating
a zigzag bend is shaped like the letter Z

explanation.surface: An officer in south London rounded a corner hesitantly, looking for sparkling water.
explanation.definitionFit: Seltzer is carbonated mineral water, originally from Selters in Germany.

clue.text: Vulgar when backing out of expedition

indicators.note: the turned letters are taken out of the expedition word

parts.note: a crusade is a military expedition

indicators.note: the word for when is turned backwards

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I left'

clue.text: Gave it a whirl for instance during distribution of seed

the letters of seed are spread out in a new order

parts.note: say means for instance, as in 'pick a fruit, say an apple'

explanation.definitionFit: To essay something is to attempt it, to have a go.

clue.text: Very much inclined to be pricy

explanation.surface: Someone is very keen to be expensive.

clue.text: Wee lover!

clue.text: Third half of hemidemisemiquaver

clue.text: Don't start to bring design

parts.note: to fetch is to go and bring something back

clue.text: Unfair, a question about the country

clue.text: Artist calling home, 'e became disorientated

clue.text: Either way this bread looks the same
